start.title: Las Llanuras de Moab
start.text:
Israel descansa al borde de la promesa.
Tus años terminan ahora en el río.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Press on and cross with them
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The Lord told you not to cross.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Gather the people one last time
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You call them with quiet love.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Say nothing and slip away alone
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] They deserve a farewell.

press_consequence.title: Honra Su Palabra
press_consequence.text:
El Jordán no es tuyo para cruzar.
Reúne al pueblo en su lugar.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Gather the people one last time
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You bow and turn back.

silent_consequence.title: Necesitan Tu Bendición
silent_consequence.text:
Cuarenta años caminaron juntos.
No los dejes en silencio.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Gather the people one last time
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You raise your staff to call them.

gather_people.title: Todo Israel Escucha
gather_people.text:
Sus rostros esperan, callados e inmóviles.
¿Qué palabras les darás?

choices.text: [TODO:es] Recount your own great deeds
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your story is His story.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Remind them of the Lord's faithfulness
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You speak of manna and sea.

boast_consequence.title: Exalta Su Nombre, No el Tuyo
boast_consequence.text:
Él te guio. Él te alimentó. Él te salvó.
Que lo recuerden a Él.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Remind them of the Lord's faithfulness
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your voice softens with truth.

blessing.title: Una Bendición sobre las Tribus
blessing.text:
Bendices a cada tribu por su nombre.
Tu cayado tiembla de amor.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Now appoint your successor
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Leadership must continue.

appoint_joshua.title: ¿Quién los Guiará?
appoint_joshua.text:
Josué está a tu lado, firme.
El Señor lo ha elegido.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Choose someone of your own bloodline
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The Lord chose Joshua, not kin.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Cling to leadership a little longer
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your time has come to release it.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Lay your hands on Joshua
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Spirit and wisdom pass to him.

bloodline_consequence.title: Su Elección, No la Tuya
bloodline_consequence.text:
Josué ha caminado a tu lado todo el tiempo.
El Señor lo ha nombrado.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Lay your hands on Joshua
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You turn toward Joshua.

cling_consequence.title: Abre Tu Mano
cling_consequence.text:
La fidelidad ahora significa soltar.
Da lo que Él te pide.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Lay your hands on Joshua
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your hands come to rest on him.

joshua_blessed.title: Sé Fuerte y Valiente
joshua_blessed.text:
"El Señor va delante de ti", dices.
"Él no te abandonará".

choices.text: [TODO:es] Now climb Mount Nebo as God said
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The mountain waits in the dawn.

ascent.title: El Camino Hacia el Nebo
ascent.text:
Cada paso es pesado y santo.
En la cima, el Señor hablará.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Turn back to the comfort of camp
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] He calls you upward, not back.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Climb in quiet trust
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your staff steadies your steps.

turnback_consequence.title: Él Espera Arriba
turnback_consequence.text:
Esta última subida es Su regalo para ti.
No rechaces la cumbre.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Climb in quiet trust
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You turn your face upward.

summit.title: Toda la Tierra Ante Ti
summit.text:
Valles y colinas brillan en oro.
"Esta es la tierra", dice Él.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Grieve that you may not enter
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You have already received enough.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Demand to cross with the people
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] His word is gentle but firm.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Receive the vision with thanks
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Tears of joy fall in silence.

grief_consequence.title: Mira con Alegría, No con Tristeza
grief_consequence.text:
Él te permite ver lo que prometió.
Esta visión es Su bondad.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Receive the vision with thanks
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Your heart softens at His mercy.

demand_consequence.title: Confía en Su Límite
demand_consequence.text:
Josué los guiará al otro lado.
Tu parte está completa.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Receive the vision with thanks
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] You bow your head in peace.

vision_received.title: "Lo Has Visto con Tus Ojos"
vision_received.text:
Su voz se asienta como un viento cálido.
Tu viaje llega a su descanso.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Lie down where He has appointed
choices.feedback: [TODO:es] The mountain holds you gently.

ending_peaceful.title: Descansa en la Montaña
ending_peaceful.text:
Cierras los ojos en Su presencia.
El Señor mismo entierra a Su siervo.
